tls_options.tls_config: custom CA certificate via registerTLSConfig when PEM data is provided

staging.staging_file_source: S3 or MinIO object storage via loadFileDownloader
staging.s3_copy_engine: optional UseS3CopyEngineForLoading for bulk S3 ingestion, enabled per workspace via s3EngineEnabledWorkspaceIDs
staging.random_load_delay: configurable per-workspace jitter to spread load across cluster nodes

event_tables.description: Removes duplicate entries with the same sorting key value, keeping the latest version

user_tables.description: Aggregation logic before merging records with same user id; replaces user properties with the latest non-null values via SimpleAggregateFunction(anyLast, ...)

cluster_replication.enabled: configurable via destination config cluster setting
cluster_replication.distributed_tables: cluster mode creates distributed views over replicated local tables

schema_management.schema_creation: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS via CreateSchema
schema_management.table_creation: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS with engine-specific DDL

nullable_handling.disable_nullable: When disableNullable is true, columns use base types with default values instead of Nullable wrappers

user_table_aggregation.description: User table columns use SimpleAggregateFunction to merge latest non-null values during background merges

bulk_insert.method: Prepared INSERT statement via clickhouse-go driver
bulk_insert.description: Rows are streamed via prepared INSERT statements from decompressed gzipped CSV records into the target table within a transaction
bulk_insert.null_handling: empty strings are trimmed to nil; type coercion applied per column
bulk_insert.type_coercion: typecastDataFromType coerces int, float, bool, datetime, and array values; castStringToArray handles JSON array parsing

deduplication.strategy: ReplacingMergeTree engine handles deduplication during background merges by sorting key
deduplication.description: ClickHouse natively deduplicates rows with the same sorting key values during background merge operations, keeping the latest version based on insertion order

identity_merge.description: LoadUserTables maintains union staging tables for identity streams, deduplicates existing rows, and refreshes identities atomically

sample_users_event.column_type_note: User columns wrapped in SimpleAggregateFunction(anyLast, Nullable(<type>)) for last-value aggregation during merges

field_mappings.note: RudderStack-unique. No Segment equivalent for comparison.
field_mappings.loading_method: Bulk INSERT via clickhouse-go driver; no Segment ClickHouse destination exists for comparison
field_mappings.column_naming: RudderStack uses snake_case column names (e.g., context_library_name, original_timestamp, received_at)
field_mappings.type_system: Rudder types are mapped to ClickHouse types: int→Int64, float→Float64, string→String, datetime→DateTime, boolean→UInt8 (ClickHouse has no native bool type)
field_mappings.special_columns: event and event_text columns use LowCardinality(String) for optimized cardinality storage
field_mappings.table_engine_strategy: Event tables use ReplacingMergeTree for deduplication; user tables use AggregatingMergeTree with SimpleAggregateFunction(anyLast, ...) for last-value merge semantics
field_mappings.cluster_replication: When cluster setting is configured, engines are prefixed with Replicated (e.g., ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree) with ZooKeeper path-based coordination
field_mappings.partitioning: All tables partitioned by toDate(received_at) for efficient date-range pruning
field_mappings.nullable_handling: Configurable via disableNullable: when disabled, columns use base types with default sentinel values (0 for int/bool, 0.0 for float, 1970-01-01 for datetime) instead of Nullable wrappers
field_mappings.staging_strategy: Gzipped CSV file download from object storage with optional S3 COPY engine for bulk ingestion; deduplication handled natively by ReplacingMergeTree engine during background merges
field_mappings.array_support: ClickHouse supports native array types: Array(Int64), Array(Float64), Array(String), Array(DateTime), Array(UInt8) mapped from Rudder array types

notes: ClickHouse is a RudderStack-unique warehouse destination. There is no Segment ClickHouse destination, so payload parity comparison is not applicable. RudderStack loads data via Bulk INSERT using the clickhouse-go driver with configurable TLS support, gzipped CSV file download from object storage (with optional S3 COPY engine for bulk ingestion), ReplacingMergeTree engine for event table deduplication, AggregatingMergeTree engine for user table last-value merge semantics, cluster replication via Replicated engine variants with ZooKeeper coordination, LowCardinality(String) optimization for event columns, configurable nullable handling, native array type support, and comprehensive observability metrics. The warehouse integration is located at warehouse/integrations/clickhouse/. MSSQL is the only other RudderStack-unique warehouse destination.
